home_contract.focus: Person's today, never forced Project selection
home_contract.question_threshold: answer materially changes safety, inclusion, rank or next step

advice_identity_contract.non_automation: Advice never creates or executes an action.

future_influence: Only explicitly confirmed MEM-CAND with declared scope, expiry and revocation can influence a later date. A click, silence, acknowledgement, execution or result alone is insufficient.
missing_or_unsafe_information: Do not create health/fitness advice when high-value safety input is missing, conflicting, expired or unauthorized. Stop or degrade to rest/record/professional support, without diagnosis/treatment.
classification: candidate UX and trust contract; no page or runtime implementation is frozen
